tests.name: Quick Check
tests.description: Timed check on B9 Pathogens And Disease

questions.question: Q1. What is a pathogen? Foundation [2 marks]
questions.explanation: Answer: Bacteria — e.g. Salmonella / Gonorrhoea (1 mark)

questions.question: Q2. Name the four types of pathogen and give one example disease caused by each. Foundation [4 marks]
questions.correctAnswer: Viruses — e.g. HIV/AIDS / Measles / Tobacco mosaic virus (1 mark)
questions.explanation: Answer: Viruses — e.g. HIV/AIDS / Measles / Tobacco mosaic virus (1 mark)

questions.question: Q3. Describe how Salmonella is spread and explain two ways to prevent infection. Foundation Higher [4 marks]
questions.correctAnswer: Fungi — e.g. Rose black spot (1 mark)
questions.explanation: Answer: Fungi — e.g. Rose black spot (1 mark)

questions.question: Q4. Malaria is spread by mosquitoes. Explain how the mosquito acts as a vector for the malaria protist. Foundation Higher [3 marks]
